methodology_note: Backfilled on 29 Oct 2026 with the same 7-parameter method as W44 (Tech 20%, Sentiment/New-feature/Engagement/Support 15% each, Historical 10%, Transparency 10%). Evidence: newest 60 Google Play reviews per broker as of the week's end (dated, India store). Technical reliability, Sentiment and Support are recomputed for the week; Engagement, Transparency and New-feature response are held at W44 values (no dated history). X/Reddit/App Store enrichment used in W44 is not available for past weeks. Confidence: High if 40+ of the 60 reviews fall inside the week, Medium 20-39, Low under 20.
